items.title: Ben Sidran interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 15, 2023
items.q: he’d go up to Mac Rebennack and Mac would show him something

ctx.x: And you got to see Blue Mitchell doing a hip little dance as he listened to a playback.

Oh my God, I love Blue Mitchell. And so my son, God bless him, he would never let me show him anything, tell him anything about music or anything. And I did not encourage him. But I love hanging out with him. He’s just a great guy. And so his whole life was spent on the road or in recording studios, and I couldn’t show him piano but he’d go up to Mac Rebennack and Mac would show him something and he’d carry on with other musicians. But never with me. He would never interact with me until later when he got to be…
It’s harder to do the math the farther we go, doesn’t it?
